notes.title: Release v2.6.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052656/dcff52069df14706397537c5dde3c9a7b8860e42.png[/img]

One more release to round off the year. Hope you enjoy! :)

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Introducing [b]Custom Text Labels[/b] 🏷️ 
  [list]
  [*] Users can now provide a custom title/message to go along with their timers.
  [*] Handy to remember what task you are currently working on/suppose to be doing.
  [/list]
[*] Added [b]Timer State Indicators[/b] ⏯️ 
  [list]
  [*] 
    Added a small icon to each timer to indicate what state it is currently in: Setup, Running, Paused, or Completed.
  [/list]
[*] Improve UX: [b]Retain Pomodoro Progress [/b]
  [list]
  [*] Unity Pomodoro will now retain and load your pomodoro progress between sessions.
  [*] Added Steam Cloud support for already acquired/collected pomodoros. 
  [list]
  [*] No more having to skip through multiple timers to get back to your previous progress. Instead we'll save/load tomato progress across devices with Steam Cloud.
  [/list]
  [/list]
[*] Small [b]Bugfixes[/b] 🦗
[/list]

[h1]Authors Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] If you'd like to get updates on development and see what I'm up to: [url=https://twitter.com/AdrianMiasik]@AdrianMiasik[/url]
  [list]
  [*] I tend to post and re-tweet blog posts, art, game dev content, Unity learning resources, and other software dev related topics. If that's your jam, check it out!
  [*] I also have a blog I occasionally post on: [url=https://www.adrian-miasik.com/blog.html]https://www.adrian-miasik.com/blog.html[/url]
  [/list]
[*] If you have any opinions/requests/ideas on something you'd like to see added, please comment away in the discussion!
[*] For those that wish to support this project (and fund further development), you can donate via [url=https://github.com/sponsors/adrian-miasik]GitHub Sponsors[/url]. ❤️ 
[/list]

[h1]🛠 Specifications[/h1]
[list]
[*] Project Size (Zipped): ~28-41 MB
[*] Contributor(s): [url=https://github.com/adrian-miasik]@adrian-miasik[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Release v2.5.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052656/c9600d474fe0b06bf10880b797df03fa4371d2a4.png[/img]

Update time!
We got some goodies some people have been asking for, but first...

Special thanks to the people that wrote in and reported the issues pertaining to our Unity Cloud Builds:
[list]
[*] [url=https://github.com/AyshaLyre]@AyshaLyre[/url] 👍 ([url=https://github.com/adrian-miasik/unity-pomodoro/issues/104]#104[/url])
[*] [url=https://github.com/KingWazzack]@KingWazzack[/url]👍 ([url=https://github.com/adrian-miasik/unity-pomodoro/issues/109]#109[/url])
[/list]

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Introducing support for [b]Custom Runtime Audio![/b]  🔊
  [list]
  [*] Users can now provide custom [b].mp3[/b] or [b].wav[/b] files and use them to set a custom alarm sound!
  [*] This feature was highly requested. I've wrote up the appropriate documentation here:
    [list]
  [*]📝 Tutorial: [url=https://adrian-miasik.github.io/unity-pomodoro-docs/documents/how-to-use-custom-audio.html]How to Use Custom Audio[/url]
    [/list]
  [/list]
[*] Added a [b]1-Click Quick Switch Button[/b] ⏲️ 
  [list]
  [*] The timestamp bubble that appears at the bottom right of the screen is now interactable.
  [*] Pressing this button will instantly return you back to your active timer. The behaviour is the same as clicking the 'Pomodoro Timer' row from the sidebar menu. The intent is to be able to return to the timer with a single button click instead of having to open the sidebar menu every time. (Suggested by Steam user 'Carthes')
  [/list]
[*] Added in [b]3 more additional pre-installed alarm sounds![/b] 🎶 
  [list]
  [*] You can now set your preferred alarm sounds in the settings page 
  [/list]
[*] Implemented [b]Quantum Console[/b] 🛠️ 
  [list]
  [*] We now have a console implemented for development and debugging purposes. Primarily intended for developer use but also available to tech-savvy  users. Currently disabled for this release, but available in-editor.
  [*] Moving forward we will be adding commands to this with ways to manipulate/control your timers.
  [/list]
[*] [b]Visual Improvements[/b]
  [list]
  [*] Added additional 'True Shadows' to our UI elements
  [*] Fixed a couple visual artifacts
  [/list]
[/list]

[h1]Authors Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] UWP version is now live on the Microsoft Store.
[*] Android version will be available on the Google Play Store in a ~weeks time of this post.
[*] If you'd like to get updates on development and see what I'm up to: [url=https://twitter.com/AdrianMiasik]@AdrianMiasik[/url]

  [*] I tend to post and re-tweet blog posts, art, game dev content, Unity learning resources, and other software dev related topics. If that's your jam, check it out!
  [*] I also have a blog I occasionally post on: [url=https://www.adrian-miasik.com/blog.html]https://www.adrian-miasik.com/blog.html[/url]
  [/list]
[*] If you have any opinions/requests/ideas on something you'd like to see added, please comment away in the discussion!
[*] For those that wish to support this project (and fund further development), you can donate via [url=https://github.com/sponsors/adrian-miasik]GitHub Sponsors[/url]. ❤️ 
[/list]

We've released the Steam version of the app earlier this week and I saw some people leave some positive reviews there, so many thanks for those! We've also had a couple people report in some bugs/issues with the previous 2.4.0 release. This hotfix release should address some of those concerns.

notes.title: Unity Pomodoro is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Unity Pomodoro is now available on the Steam Store! (v.2.4.0)

If you'd like to download Unity Pomodoro for other platforms, check out the GitHub releases page: https://github.com/adrian-miasik/unity-pomodoro/releases

Code is open-source and changes are definitely most welcome. Be sure to check out the contribution document for more information on how to contribute.

If you'd love to see a specific feature or report a bug, the Steam forums or the GitHub page are both acceptable places to post your feature wishlist, worries, and/or concerns. I'll be keeping an eye out on both platforms.

Thanks for the support thus far.

-Adrian
